title: Grade 7 CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — General Assessment #3

pages.quiz:
CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Red, blue, and yellow
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Brown, pink, and gold

2. Best practice when working on Javelin and Sculpture: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Javelin and Sculpture.
   B. Practise Javelin and Sculpture with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Javelin and Sculpture.
   D. Damage equipment used for Javelin and Sculpture.

3. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

4. Best practice when working on Drawing and Painting: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Drawing and Painting.
   B. Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Drawing and Painting.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Drawing and Painting.

5. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   B. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.

6. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.

7. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   B. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   D. Damage equipment used for Melody.

8. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.
   D. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.

9. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Games: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   C. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Games.

10. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. The ticket price
   C. Only the costume
   D. The speed of the music

11. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Damage equipment used for Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.
   C. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Storytelling and Animation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Football and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Folk Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts and Sports and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — Red, blue, and yellow

2. B — Practise Javelin and Sculpture with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. D — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

4. B — Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. B — Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. A — Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. B — Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. A — Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. C — Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. D — The speed of the music

11. D — Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. A — Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Storytelling and Animation; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Football; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Kenyan Folk Songs; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Analysis of Creative Arts and Sports; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
